items.title: What Does McCormick (MKC) Leaving A Major World Index Mean?
items.summary: McCormick (NYSE: MKC) has been removed from the FTSE All-World Index, according to the latest index review. The change affects passive funds and ETFs that track the FTSE All-World benchmark and previously held McCormick shares. Index removal can influence trading liquidity for McCormick as index-tracking investors adjust their portfolios. items.title: Hormel’s 60-Year Dividend Streak Masks a Troubling Reality: Raises Are Shrinking

items.title: McCormick or Smucker: One Dividend Aristocrat Will Outrun the Other
items.summary: Two consumer staples giants share nearly identical yields and market caps yet have moved in opposite directions this year by a staggering 54 percentage points. Before you chase the winner, consider which one actually belongs in a retirement account built to last decades.
